```yaml
name: Docker Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - beta
      - next
    tags:
      - '*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - beta
      - next

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build and push Docker image (${{ matrix.variant }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: docker-${{ matrix.variant }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    strategy:
      matrix:
        variant: [io, beta, main, next]
      fail-fast: false
    env:
      DOCKER_BUILDKIT: 1
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Cache node modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.npm
            ~/.cache/yarn
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ matrix.variant }}-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ hashFiles('**/yarn.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ matrix.variant }}-${{ github.ref_name }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ matrix.variant }}-

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: Dockerfile
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
          push: true
          tags: |
            misskeyio/misskey:${{ matrix.variant }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
          cache-from: type=registry,ref=misskeyio/misskey-cache:${{ matrix.variant }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
          cache-to: type=registry,ref=misskeyio/misskey-cache:${{ matrix.variant }}-${{ github.ref_name }},mode=max
```
